The planet [[Nalyd]] was home to a species of '''floating jellyfish-like creatures''' that were capable of flying through the skies. During an attempt to rescue [[Darth Wredd]]'s [[Nalydian]] henchman [[Dieben]], the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] commandeered a floating jellyfish and grabbed it by its tendrils. Later, his friend [[Ania Solo]] and Dieben clung on to the creature. However, their weight caused the tentacle to break off and threw everyone down into a swamp below. While Jao and Ania survived the fall, Dieben was impaled by a sharp, thorny plant, leading to injuries which resulted in his death.
